votes.motion: Approve an order of conditions for the Landry Notice of Intent (1078 Lancaster Ave), with added erosion-control conditions.
votes.quote: a motion was made to approve an order of conditions with added conditions concerning the enhanced the erosion control. the motion was made by jr and seconded by ml.

votes.motion: Continue the Kevin Hill hearing (41 Country Lane) to the December 1st meeting at 7:00 PM.
votes.quote: the meeting was continued to the december 1st meeting at 7:00 pm by a motion of cc with a second by jr and a unanimous vote of the commission to approve the motion

votes.motion: Continue the Matthew Butterworth hearing (188 Whalom Road) to December 1, 2021.
votes.quote: it was continued to the december 1, 2021 meeting by a motion of cc and a second by jr with a unanimous vote by roll call to approve the motion.

votes.motion: Issue a negative determination for the Leblanc Request for a Determination (1390 Lancaster Ave), shed in buffer zone.
votes.quote: emotion was made to issue a negative determination by cc with a second by ml. the motion was approved unanimously by a roll call vote

votes.motion: Approve only the rehabilitation of the existing screened-in porch at 35 Peninsula Drive; the proposed addition is denied and removed from consideration.
votes.quote: a motion was made to approve only the rehabilitation of the existing screened in porch with the proposed addition being denied and removed from consideration by ml with a second from jr.

votes.motion: Negative determination for 37 Pearl Street: remove the wall, regrade, remove the side walkway section, and move the shed.
votes.quote: moving of the shed was also included as part of the motion by ml with a second by jv. the motion was approved unanimously by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Continue the 101 Pleasant Street Notice of Intent (MA Pleasant LLC) to December 1st, with the applicant's consent.
votes.quote: with consent to the applicant the meeting was continued to december 1st by a motion of jr and a second by jv.

votes.motion: Allow the release of the Holman St. and Northfield Road parcels (61A release request) for purchase.
votes.quote: motion was made to allow the release of the property by jr and seconded by cc with a unanimous vote to approve the motion by roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve payment of $600 for pest control and $800 for two septic pumpings at 123 Hollis Road.
votes.quote: a motion was made to approve the amounts by jr with a second by cc. the motion was approved by a unanimous roll call vote.

votes.motion: Approve the administrator's determination to remove two dead trees at 135 Flynn Rd.
votes.quote: the commission approved the administrator's determination with the motion by jr and a second by cc with a unanimous roll call vote approving the motion.
the meeting was adjourned at 10:13 pm with a motion from jr and the second from ml with a unanimous roll call vote to approve the motion.
